title: Inquiry Form Submission with Valid Inputs
description: Verify that the inquiry form accepts valid inputs, submits asynchronously, and displays success feedback.

steps.description: Navigate to main landing page
Fill in all required inquiry form fields with valid data
Submit the inquiry form
Check that the form submission API call returns success
Verify UI shows confirmation message indicating successful submission

title: Inquiry Form Submission with Missing Required Fields
description: Verify that submitting the inquiry form with missing mandatory fields prevents submission and shows appropriate validation messages.

steps.description: Navigate to main landing page
Leave one or more required fields empty in the inquiry form
Submit the inquiry form
Check that no API submission request is made
Verify validation messages are shown near respective empty fields

title: Inquiry Form Submission with Invalid Data Formats
description: Verify that the form validation detects and rejects invalid input formats (e.g., invalid email) and shows error messages.

steps.description: Navigate to main landing page
Fill inquiry form fields with invalid data formats (e.g., incorrect email format)
Attempt to submit the form
Validate that the form does not submit and error messages appear for invalid inputs

title: Public Inquiry List Loading on Page Load
description: Verify the public inquiry list is fetched from backend and displayed correctly on page load.

steps.description: Navigate to public inquiry listing section on landing page
Check that an API request to get-public-list is made and returns inquiries
Verify the inquiries are rendered correctly in the list

title: Public Inquiry List Displays 'No Inquiries' if Empty
description: Confirm that if no public inquiries exist, the listing area shows the appropriate 'No inquiries' message.

steps.description: Ensure backend returns an empty inquiry list
Navigate to public inquiry listing section
Verify that the message 'No inquiries' is displayed instead of an empty list

title: Incremental Loading of Public Inquiries via 'Load More' Button
description: Verify that clicking the 'Load More' button fetches additional inquiries and appends them to the list.

steps.description: Navigate to public inquiry listing section
Click on repeatedly the 'Load More' button
Check that subsequent API calls fetch the next inquiries pages
Verify that the new inquiries are appended rather than replacing existing list

title: Password Verification for Inquiry Detail Viewing Success
description: Check that entering the correct password allows viewing detailed inquiry and admin reply.

steps.description: From public inquiry list, select an inquiry requiring password
Enter the correct password in the verification prompt
Submit the password for verification
Verify backend verifies password and returns inquiry and admin reply details
Check that detailed view is displayed with correct content

title: Password Verification for Inquiry Detail Viewing Failure
description: Verify that incorrect password entry prevents access to inquiry details and shows error message.

steps.description: Select a password-protected inquiry from the list
Input an incorrect password in the verification prompt
Submit the password
Ensure backend returns authentication failure response
Check UI displays error message about incorrect password and denies access

title: Admin Login and Viewing Inquiry List
description: Verify that the admin can access the dashboard, load the list of inquiries, and see data correctly.

steps.description: Navigate to the admin dashboard page
Perform admin login if authentication is required
Check that the inquiry list is loaded via admin page API
Verify the listings show correct inquiry data

title: Admin Sends Reply to Inquiry
description: Verify that admin can input a reply to an inquiry, submit it successfully, and see updated data in dashboard.

steps.description: In admin dashboard, select an inquiry to reply
Enter a reply message into the reply interface
Submit the reply
Verify backend admin-reply API responds with success
Check that the inquiry record updates with the new reply in the admin dashboard

title: Localization Toggle Between English and Korean
description: Verify that toggling the language setting updates all relevant UI text between English and Korean correctly.

steps.description: Navigate to any page with visible text (e.g., main page)
Toggle the language selector from English to Korean
Validate all text elements update to their Korean translations
Toggle the language selector back to English
Confirm all text switches back to English correctly

title: UI Interactions: Open and Close Product Detail Modal
description: Verify that clicking on product details opens the modal, and that the modal can be closed properly without layout issues.

steps.description: On main page, click a product detail link or button
Confirm the product detail modal opens with correct content
Close the modal via close button or overlay click
Verify the modal closes cleanly and no UI artifacts remain

title: UI Interactions: MSDS Popup Display and Close
description: Verify that the MSDS popup can be triggered and dismissed without visual glitches or errors.

steps.description: Trigger the MSDS popup by clicking the relevant UI element
Verify the MSDS popup is displayed with correct content
Close the MSDS popup
Ensure the popup closes without layout or script errors

title: UI Interactions: Hero Carousel Slider Functionality
description: Verify that the hero carousel slider cycles through slides, responds to navigation controls, and loops correctly.

steps.description: On landing page, observe the hero carousel slider auto-advance
Confirm slides change automatically at expected intervals
Use navigation arrows or controls to manually switch slides
Check slides respond correctly to controls and loop from last to first

title: Responsive Design: Mobile Menu Toggle and Accordion Submenus
description: Verify that on narrow viewports, the mobile menu toggles open and closed, and accordion submenus expand and collapse correctly.

steps.description: Resize viewport to mobile width breakpoint
Click mobile menu toggle button to open menu
Verify the mobile menu panel slides in and is visible
Click submenu accordion headers
Confirm submenus expand and collapse correctly
Toggle menu closed
Check menu closes and is hidden cleanly

title: Company Introduction Section: Kakao Map Loading and Rendering
description: Verify that the embedded Kakao Map loads successfully and displays without errors or visual glitches when the company introduction section is accessed.

steps.description: Navigate to company introduction section
Confirm Kakao Map triggers load and renders on the page
Check for no visible errors or broken map elements

title: Backend Functions Handle API Errors Gracefully
description: Verify backend serverless functions respond correctly under failure scenarios (e.g., invalid input, backend error) and UI shows appropriate error feedback.

steps.description: Simulate API call failures for inquiry submission, get-public-list, get-inquiry-detail, admin-reply, and verify-password endpoints
Ensure backend returns meaningful error responses
Check that frontend UI shows user-friendly error messages without crashing

title: No Broken Images or Invalid Paths on UI
description: Verify that all images load correctly on main and admin pages, with no broken image icons or 404 errors in network logs.

steps.description: Load main and admin pages fully
Inspect all images to confirm they render and no broken image placeholders are present
Review browser network logs for any 404 or resource loading errors

title: UI Scripts Execute Without Runtime Errors
description: Verify that no JavaScript runtime errors occur during normal user interactions across main and admin pages.

steps.description: Interact with various UI elements including form inputs, buttons, modals, popups, carousels, and language toggles
Check browser console logs to confirm no uncaught exceptions or runtime errors

title: Backend API Response Times Within Acceptable Thresholds
description: Verify that backend serverless functions respond promptly under typical load, meeting performance criteria for responsiveness.

steps.description: Measure response time for API calls to submit-inquiry, get-public-list, get-inquiry-detail, admin-reply, and verify-password
Confirm each response time is within the acceptable performance threshold as defined by project standards
